name: chips-social-poker
description: Social no-limit Texas Hold'em platform with play-only chips

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @poker/server" "npm run dev -w @poker/web"
scripts.dev:stable: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:once -w @poker/server" "npm run dev -w @poker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker/server && npm run build -w @poker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @poker/server && npm run typecheck -w @poker/web
